name: CheckboxGroup
description: A group container for Checkbox components. Renders a <fieldset> with a <legend> for accessible grouping. Passes the disabled prop down to child Checkbox components via context.

notes: Uses a native <fieldset> and <legend> to provide an accessible group label to screen readers.
The disabled prop is propagated to all Checkbox children via React context.
Vertical and horizontal layout are controlled via a CSS flex direction on the group container.

legend.description: The accessible label for the group. Rendered as a <legend> inside the <fieldset>. Required.

direction.description: Layout direction of the checkbox items. 'vertical' stacks them in a column; 'horizontal' places them in a row.

disabled.description: Disables all Checkbox children in the group. Passed via context.

children.description: Checkbox components to render inside the group.

className.description: Additional CSS class names to apply to the fieldset element.

do: Always provide a legend prop — it is the accessible name for the group.
Use CheckboxGroup whenever two or more related checkboxes appear together.
Use direction='horizontal' for short-label choices that fit on one line.
dont: Do not nest CheckboxGroups — keep the structure flat.
Do not omit the legend — it is required for accessibility.
Do not use CheckboxGroup for mutually exclusive choices — use RadioGroup instead.
